# Git Workflow

- Inspect status before destructive operations.
- Keep commits focused.
- Write commit messages describing intent.
- Avoid committing secrets, generated binaries, or environment-specific files.
- Resolve conflicts by understanding both sides; do not blindly accept ours/theirs.
- Before merge, ensure build/tests and migration assumptions are understood.
